title: Samsung V-NAND SSD 970 EVO — 2018 Data Sheet, Revision 1.0

locators.locator: p. 5, Hardware Information; p. 6, Product Lineup
locators.paraphrase: MZ-V7E500 is the 500GB 970 EVO; MZ-V7E1T0 is 1TB. Both specify Phoenix, Samsung V-NAND 3bit MLC, M.2 2280, PCIe 3.0 x4 and NVMe 1.3. DRAM is 512MB LPDDR4 for 500GB; 1GB for 1TB.

locators.locator: p. 5, Performance rows and footnote 3; p. 6, testing configuration
locators.paraphrase: 500GB/1TB sequential reads reach 3400MB/s; writes reach 2300/2500MB/s using TurboWrite, then 600/1200MB/s beyond its region. Values depend on firmware and host; tests use IOmeter 1.1.0, Windows 10 and an i7-7700K.
500GB/1TB ratings are 300/600TBW. Limited warranty ends at five years or rated writes, whichever occurs first.

locators.locator: p. 4, System Design Flexibility; p. 5, Hardware Information
locators.paraphrase: Package counts and locations for the 500GB variant are not stated in these sections.

limits: Manufacturer assertions; not independent benchmarks. April 2018 is document revision date, not an inferred product launch date. PDF text extraction has merged table cells; 500GB values also checked as scout leads in the model-specific Samsung support page. Do not reuse possibly mistyped 1TB retail model code from p. 6.

title: 970 EVO NVMe M.2 SSD 500GB — Samsung support

locators.locator: Page heading and Specs > General Feature, items 2–9
locators.paraphrase: The MZ-V7E500 page identifies 500GB, M.2 2280, PCIe Gen 3.0 x4 with NVMe 1.3, Samsung V-NAND 3-bit MLC, Phoenix controller and Samsung 512MB Low Power DDR4 SDRAM.

limits: Same publisher as datasheet, not independent corroboration. Korean support page includes English specification labels.

title: Specifications

locators.locator: NVMe Set of Specifications Overview, first paragraph
locators.paraphrase: NVMe defines host communication with nonvolatile memory. NVM Express is the nonprofit consortium defining and managing the technology; PCIe is one supported transport.

limits: Current overview; does not establish that a 2018 device implements current specification features.

locators.locator: Base Specification archive, entries NVM Express 1.3a through 1.3d and Changes in NVMe Revision 1.3

limits: The device's exact 1.3 letter revision is unknown; do not substitute transport specification 1.3 from 2025.
